timely.label: Gas Prices
timely.line: Missouri's average for regular gas is $3.82 today, down 24 cents from a month ago and up $1.15 from a year ago, according to AAA. Springfield averages $3.70. Fill up before it changes its mind.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Archery deer season ends Friday, Nov. 13, in 10 days. Time to make those last sits count.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: The November portion of firearms deer season opens Saturday, Nov. 14, in 11 days, and runs through Nov. 24. Alarm clocks will be set very early.

timely.label: Hunting Season
timely.line: Youth firearms deer season opens Friday, Nov. 27, in 24 days, and runs through Nov. 29. Kids get first dibs.

timely.label: Veterans Day
timely.line: Veterans Day is Wednesday, Nov. 11, in 8 days. A good week to thank a veteran.

timely.label: Thanksgiving
timely.line: Thanksgiving is Thursday, Nov. 26, in 23 days. Start practicing your stretchy pants.

timely.label: TV Anniversary
timely.line: The sitcom The Nanny premiered on CBS in 1993 with Fran Drescher as Fran Fine. That laugh still carries.

timely.label: TV Anniversary
timely.line: Diff'rent Strokes premiered on NBC in 1978, starring Gary Coleman and Todd Bridge with Conrad Bain. Whatchu talkin' 'bout, 48 years?

timely.label: Country Anniversary
timely.line: Shania Twain released Come On Over in 1997, the best-selling country album ever by a female artist in the U.S. Still makes you feel like a woman.

timely.label: Movie Anniversary
timely.line: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone premiered at Odeon Leicester Square in London in 2001, 25 years ago. Time to dust off the wands.

timely.label: Country Anniversary
timely.line: Johnny Cash released American IV: The Man Comes Around in 2002, the album with his cover of "Hurt" and his last studio release in his lifetime. A country classic.

timely.label: Movie Night
timely.line: The animated Cat in the Hat, with Bill Hader voicing the Cat, opens Friday, Nov. 6, in theaters. Family movie night, sorted.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: The Missouri Department of Conservation is hosting November events across the Southwest Region on fly tying, woodcarving and winter bird feeding. Free skills, no gear shopping first.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: A MeatEater episode says the rut won't make up for low-effort sits: put in the time, then pivot to new spots when plans fail. Patience beats luck.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Counter-drone technology has reached deer hunting, and landowners are starting to fight back against unwanted drone activity on their property. Even deer want privacy.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A tire can have good tread and still be too old: the age is a four-digit number stamped on the sidewall that almost nobody reads. Time to check the fine print.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Mortgage rates slid noticeably lower Monday, Nov. 2, enough to catch home buyers' attention. Good news for house hunters.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: New cars now average over $50,000, and only six brands average under $40,000, with Mitsubishi cheapest at $33,957. Maybe keep that old truck running.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: NerdWallet says to trade time and extra thought to make a $50 holiday gift feel like $100. Thoughtful beats expensive.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Walmart will have three major shopping events this holiday season, not just Black Friday. More chances to save, or to overspend.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit dad found a sweet note from his 9-year-old son in the lunch box at the end of the day, though nearly everything he packed came back home. Love note, lunch untouched.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit mom says her 5-year-old knocked on doors, peeked in the candy bowls and said no thanks, he didn't like anything. Picky even about free candy.
